import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
conn.execute("CREATE TABLE authors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")

conn.execute("INSERT INTO authors (id, name) VALUES (1, 'Alice')")
conn.execute("INSERT INTO books (id, title, author_id) VALUES (1, 'Book', 1)")
conn.commit()

conn.execute("BEGIN")
conn.execute("PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=ON")
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE authors_new (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, full_name TEXT)')
conn.execute('INSERT INTO authors_new (rowid, id, full_name) SELECT rowid, id, name FROM authors')
conn.execute('ALTER TABLE authors RENAME TO authors_old')

print("books schema:", conn.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='books'").fetchone()[0])
conn.execute('DROP TABLE authors_old')
print("after drop old, books count:", conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM books").fetchone()[0])
conn.execute('ALTER TABLE authors_new RENAME TO authors')
conn.execute("PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=OFF")
conn.execute("COMMIT")
print("final books:", conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM books").fetchone()[0])
print("final authors:", conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM authors").fetchone()[0])
print("fk_check:", conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall())
print("books schema:", conn.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='books'").fetchone()[0])
print("authors schema:", conn.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='authors'").fetchone()[0])

import sqlite3

def trial(setup_pragma):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE authors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, author_id INTEGER REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)")
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO authors VALUES (1, 'Alice')")
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO books VALUES (1, 'Book', 1)")
    conn.commit()
    conn.execute("BEGIN")
    setup_pragma(conn)
    print("  fk pragma now:", conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys").fetchone()[0],
          "defer:", conn.execute("PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys").fetchone()[0])
    conn.execute("DROP TABLE authors")
    print("  books after drop:", conn.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM books").fetchone()[0])
    conn.rollback()

print("defer_foreign_keys=ON:")
trial(lambda c: c.execute("PRAGMA defer_foreign_keys=ON"))
print("foreign_keys=OFF (inside txn):")
trial(lambda c: c.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF"))
EOF

import sqlite3

def test(label, create_child, pragma_before=False, pragma_scope="before_txn"):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    if pragma_before:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=ON")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE authors (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT)")
    conn.execute(create_child)
    conn.commit()
    if not pragma_before:
        conn.execute("BEGIN")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA legacy_alter_table=ON")
    conn.execute('ALTER TABLE authors RENAME TO authors_old')
    sql = conn.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE name='books'").fetchone()[0]
    print(f"{label}: {sql}")

test("inline", "CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, author_id INTEGER REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)")
test("table-level", "CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, author_id INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY(author_id) REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)")
test("named", "CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, author_id INTEGER CONSTRAINT fk_a REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)")
test("pragma-before", "CREATE TABLE books (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, author_id INTEGER REFERENCES authors(id) ON DELETE CASCADE)", pragma_before=True)
EOF
